BiblicalUsage: Shua is the name of two women, and both are named only in passing. One was the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess, the wife of Judah and mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah, and the other was the sister of Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham in Asher's line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mothers in the margins still matter. Judah's wife and Asher's daughter are named, and I hold that God writes women's names into His story even when men write them small.
